This makes HAW-18 a bet on a REGIME HOLDING, which is a weaker claim than a bet on a constant -- and it is exactly what makes the migration thesis interesting AND fragile. Correcting now rather than carrying a number I know was set on an incomplete base rate; pre-registration discipline governs drift AFTER in-window evidence arrives, not correction of a registration defect found the same session. column3: CROSS-WAR, THEATER-AGNOSTIC, MOLECULE-EXPLICIT: from 2026-08-20 through 2026-09-30, NO IRREVERSIBLE PHYSICAL LOSS OF CRUDE-OIL PRODUCTIVE OR EXPORT CAPACITY occurs in either theater -- i.e. the insurer/owner WILLINGNESS channel (FLOW-HAWK-19 branch c) remains the SOLE route by which war stress reaches the crude price. Successor to HAW-18 (FAILED 2026-08-04 on a construct mismatch, not on the world). TWO legs, both theater-agnostic, both requiring DESTROYED CAPACITY rather than offline barrels -- because KB-HAWK-236 establishes that MAGNITUDE NO LONGER DISCRIMINATES branch (a) from branch (c); only REVERSIBILITY does. LEG A (CAPACITY DESTRUCTION) fires when ALL THREE hold: (i) a NAMED crude-oil production field, stabilization/processing facility, or crude-export terminal in EITHER theater sustains CONFIRMED physical damage (primary or Tier-1 outlet; a claim is not a confirmation); AND (ii) the affected capacity is >=200 kbpd of CRUDE (FROZEN threshold, crude-denominated); AND (iii) irreversibility is evidenced by ANY ONE of -- (alpha) an operator or sovereign FORCE MAJEURE EXPLICITLY ATTRIBUTED TO PHYSICAL DAMAGE (not to security conditions, not to insurance, not to commercial terms); (beta) a restoration timeline >=90 days stated by the operator, the sovereign, or a NAMED Tier-1 technical assessor (Kpler / Vortexa / IIR / Wood Mackenzie / S&P Global Commodity Insights); (gamma) the capacity observed offline >=45 CONSECUTIVE days on a named flow instrument (Kpler or Vortexa) with NO operator statement attributing the outage to security or commercial conditions. LEG B (KINETIC DENIAL) fires when: CENTCOM's own published enforcement tally shows cumulative vessels DISABLED-or-BOARDED rising to >=10 within any rolling 14-day window (FROZEN threshold; baseline 2 disabled / 2 boarded, flat 2026-07-26 to 2026-08-09 per SIG-W-20260812-011), WITHOUT a matching rise in alternate-route throughput (SUMED / Sidi Kerir, per Kpler or Vortexa) -- i.e. DENIAL, not the REROUTING this desk verified on 2026-08-15.
column9: Resolve_By 2026-09-30. ANCHOR TYPE: IMMOVABLE (fixed calendar date; no participant, operator, sovereign or publisher can move it) -- per fleet canon finding_resolver_anchored_to_expected_event_inherits_slip_risk, registered 2026-08-19; the anchor type is named in-cell because a bare date hides which kind it is. EITHER leg fired and evidenced = FAILED. BOTH legs unfired at 2026-09-30 = CONFIRMED, but ONLY on a DATED SEARCH ATTEMPT (fleet convention ratified by Will 2026-08-17, war-triad batch row 52-3): CONFIRMED requires a logged, dated pull of (1) FALCON's and OSPREY's ledgers, (2) CENTCOM's enforcement tally at its own account, and (3) a Kpler-or-Vortexa flow check on any candidate asset. CONFIRMED must mean 'I looked and found nothing', never 'I did not look'. NO-VERDICT BAND (explicit, per finding_prereg_verdict_boundary_must_be_a_number): a LEG-A event satisfying (i)+(ii) that occurs AFTER 2026-09-15 with no (alpha)/(beta) evidence published by 2026-09-30 grades NO-VERDICT ON THAT LEG -- (gamma) is unreachable for late-window events by construction (45 days cannot have elapsed), and this row does NOT pay a CONFIRMED for an event whose irreversibility could not yet be assessed. EXPLICIT NON-FIRES, pre-registered to block the known false-marks: a REFINERY hit does NOT fire this row (products, not crude -- Orsk / Salavat / Jizan class); a POWER-PLANT, grid or desalination hit does NOT fire it (FALCON's standing trap); an LNG / gas / GTL asset does NOT fire it (Ras Laffan / Pearl GTL / South Pars class -- molecule-explicit by design); a loadings HALT, export suspension or FM attributed to SECURITY does NOT fire it (the CPC 2026-07-20/24 class, ~440 kbpd offline for a week with ZERO capacity destroyed -- this is the exact event the row is built NOT to fire on); a tanker struck, sunk, or its cargo lost does NOT fire it AT ANY SCALE (the vessel leg is DELETED, not repaired -- see Notes); a CLAIMED strike without damage confirmation does NOT fire it (the Jazan 8/13 and 8/18 class, where claim quality is falling). INSTRUMENT CAVEAT CARRIED AT REGISTRATION: WALTER flagged 2026-08-12 that 'disabled' may have been silently re-scoped across CENTCOM statements and left the question UNCHECKED. LEG B's resolution REQUIRES first confirming the definition is stable across the window; if it is not, LEG B grades NO-VERDICT rather than either direction (finding_threshold_level_is_a_measurement_not_a_constant).
column10: SUCCESSOR TO HAW-18, built FROM its post-mortem rather than around it. WHAT CHANGED, DEFECT BY DEFECT: (1) THE VESSEL LEG IS DELETED, NOT REPAIRED -- and this goes one step BEYOND the 2026-08-10 forum concurrence both siblings signed ('a vessel leg is legitimate only as a laden crude tanker whose cargo is lost'). Carrying the construct argument to its conclusion: a CARGO is a STOCK and productive capacity is a FLOW; a VLCC is ~2 mb of inventory against a claim about supply CAPACITY, so no vessel leg at any realistic scale can grade a supply-loss claim without a stock-vs-flow category error (finding_cross_entity_comparison_needs_same_perimeter). HAW-18 died on exactly this mismatch -- leg (b) measured ESCALATION SEVERITY while the row claimed SUPPLY LOSS -- and repairing the leg with a cargo qualifier would have preserved the mismatch in a LESS VISIBLE form. FLAGGED TO OSPREY AND FALCON AS A DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM THE CONCURRENCE, with reasoning, for objection. (2) NO THEATER BRACKETS. HAW-18's [FALCON theater] bracket postponed its failure nine days; both legs here are explicitly theater-agnostic and say so in their own text. (3) EVERY LEG OPERATIONAL, NONE EXEMPLARY. HAW-18 wrote FALCON's legs as tests and OSPREY's as named exemplars (CPC / Tengiz / 'a named Russian berth'); LEG A names an ASSET CLASS and a NUMBER and applies identically in both theaters. (4) MOLECULE-EXPLICIT. HAW-18's fourth defect was oil-only-by-assumption; this row says CRUDE in the claim, sets a crude-denominated threshold, and lists gas, LNG, GTL and refined products in the non-fires. (5) IRREVERSIBILITY REPLACES MAGNITUDE as the discriminator, per KB-HAWK-236. || WHY TWO LEGS AND NOT FIVE: HAW-18 had five legs and died on the one that was off-construct. A falsifier that enters DISJUNCTIVELY (any leg fires) and exits CONJUNCTIVELY (all legs quiet) is a RATCHET (finding_count_the_connectives_in_versus_out) -- every additional leg raises P(FAILED) whether or not it measures the thesis. Fewer, tighter legs is not timidity here; it is the arithmetic. || WHY 70% AND NOT 85%: the naive read of these bars says ~85%. The >=200 kbpd + irreversibility conjunction has NOT been approached once in the post-2026-06-27 regime (~7.7 weeks); Aramco has said 'no material operational or financial impact' twice in 15 days across three-to-four claimed Jazan-class strikes; and OSPREY's theater delivered the strongest single datum on 2026-08-12, when Ukraine put its most capable package of the war (Neptune anti-ship missiles + jet drones + USVs) into Sheskharis and the Black Sea Fleet's main base while NOT touching CPC -- a CAPABILITY-INDEPENDENT discrimination, far stronger evidence than a restrained one (KB-HAWK-266). I am de-rating 15 points for four named hazards, THREE OF THEM NEW SINCE HAW-18 WAS WRITTEN. (i) THE US-IRAN MOU EXPIRED BY TERM 2026-08-17 WITH NO DEAL, AND TRUMP WILL NOT EXTEND [CBS / NBC / CNBC / Times of Israel 8/17, four hosts independently, via SIG-W-20260818-001]. The post-6/27 sparing regime is the ENTIRE basis of this row, and the diplomatic scaffolding it sat on lapsed THREE DAYS BEFORE REGISTRATION. Per HAW-18's own in-session correction, production-sparing is a REGIME, not a constant -- so this is a bet on a regime holding whose nominal instrument just ran out. (ii) Iran published a NAMED Gulf energy target list (Ghawar, Abqaiq-Khurais, Ruwais-Zakum, Ras Laffan, Burgan, Sitrah -- Fars-sourced, single-channel, declaratory). Deterrence-by-publication is the benign reading and I carry the tension unresolved, but a target list is not nothing. (iii) THE WAR'S OWN FIRST PHASE PROVES A SIX-WEEK WINDOW CAN CARRY MULTIPLE QUALIFYING EVENTS: 2026-02-28 to 2026-04-09 destroyed Khurais and Manifa (-300 kbpd each), Shah + Habshan, and the East-West pipeline pump + Ju'aymah (-700 kbpd). The reference class contains BOTH regimes and I must not price only the current one -- that is precisely the error I made at HAW-18's registration and corrected in-session. (iv) MY OWN SPEC IS THE MOST LIKELY FAILURE POINT, NOT THE WORLD (finding_threshold_spec_fails_before_world). HAW-10 locus, HAW-14 catalyst, HAW-15 mechanism, HAW-18 theater-scope: four of my last rows failed on WORDING, none on judgment. A row this tightly specified has MORE surface for that class, not less, and an honest de-rate prices it. || INVERSION TEST RUN (finding_confidence_priced_against_thesis_not_letter): if the migration thesis is FALSE -- physical destruction back as the binding constraint -- LEG A fires, because that is exactly what a return to branch (a) looks like. If the thesis is TRUE, both legs stay quiet unless capacity is destroyed without transmitting, which would still correctly falsify the row's LETTER, since no-physical-loss is the migration read's PRECONDITION rather than its conclusion. The letter tracks the thesis in both directions. || INSTRUMENT SELECTION IS ITSELF A FINDING: LEG B DELIBERATELY DOES NOT USE HORMUZ TRANSIT COUNTS. That family is impeached from two directions -- BRENT impeached its own PortWatch chokepoint6 series on internal evidence (n_tanker>0 with capacity_tanker=0 on 0 of 424 pre-crisis days vs 19 of 113 war tanker-days) and demoted its zero-transit days to candidate detection artefacts; and Windward independently reports ~58% of Hormuz transits running DARK [SIG-W-20260817-004]. As of 2026-08-19 the fleet holds SIX readings spanning 0 to 12 for adjacent days across at least four unstated perimeters, with ZERO comparable pairs [SIG-W-20260819-011]. An AIS-derived count is permitted to refute in ONE direction only. CENTCOM's disabled/boarded tally is a DIFFERENT OBJECT: a count of DISCRETE ADJUDICATED EVENTS published by a single named authority alongside the redirect count IN THE SAME STATEMENT -- which is what made the flat 2/2 a SOURCED NEGATIVE rather than an absence. That property is why LEG B is gradeable and a transit leg would not be. It also means BRENT's KILL-LEG2-TRANSIT -- which BRENT believes may be STRUCTURALLY UNFIREABLE (fires at >35 transits/day x2 while war-regime n_total maxes ~8) -- must NOT be treated as a cross-check on this row. Flagged to BRENT. || MEASUREMENT: LEG A grades off FALCON's and OSPREY's own ledgers plus an independent primary check; I keep no competing copy (CLAUDE.md OUTPUT RULES, one source of truth per metric). LEG B grades off CENTCOM direct. || REGISTERED AT THE ~2026-08-24 SUNSET CHECKPOINT as one of the two conditions Will ruled on 2026-08-15 (a dated gradeable row + a successor falsification surface). The surface is thesis/FALSIFICATION.md, written the same session.

column3: DORMANT BOOK / CODIFICATION AXIS -- the asymmetry this desk has asserted in STATUS section 3 since 2026-08-10 ('one theater SUSPENDS risk, the other MOVES TO TARIFF it; suspensions unwind, codified costs do not') is registered as a FALSIFIABLE RATCHET CLAIM for the first time. Through 2026-10-31, NO instrument on the cross-theater codification axis moves DOWN a status step, where the ladder is DRAFTED -> PASSED -> IMPLEMENTED -> ENFORCED (VX-HAWK-CODIF-01, FALCON-concurred spec, registered 2026-08-10, whose mandatory DOWN direction this row is the first test of). FAILED if ANY ONE of the four registered instruments SOFTENS: (a) US Section 301 forced-labor tariffs (60 economies, effective 2026-07-24) suspended, enjoined, rescinded, or their HEADLINE RATE cut; (b) US Section 338 Canada tariffs (+50%, effective 2026-08-19) suspended, enjoined, rescinded, or their HEADLINE RATE cut; (c) the Iranian Hormuz transit-toll bill (7% of cargo value, at DRAFTED) formally withdrawn or tabled by the Majlis; (d) the Mecca pact (Turkey's accession to the September-2025 Saudi-Pakistan Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement) publicly repudiated or exited by any signatory. CONFIRMED = all four instruments at or above their 2026-08-20 rung on 2026-10-31.
column9: Resolve_By 2026-10-31. ANCHOR TYPE: IMMOVABLE (fixed calendar date) -- per finding_resolver_anchored_to_expected_event_inherits_slip_risk. SOFTENING IS DEFINED NARROWLY AND THE DEFINITION IS THE POINT OF THE ROW: only a REDUCTION IN THE HEADLINE RATE, or a SUSPENSION / INJUNCTION / RESCISSION OF THE ACTION AS A WHOLE, fires a leg. PRODUCT-LEVEL CARVE-OUTS, ANNEX CLARIFICATIONS AND EXCLUSION PROCESSES EXPLICITLY DO NOT FIRE -- a ratchet claim is about an instrument's EXISTENCE AND LEVEL, not its COVERAGE. This clause is written to dispose of a known live ambiguity in my own book rather than leave it to be read in at resolution: STATUS section 6 records that whether autos/motor vehicles are IN or OUT of the Section 338 annex is UNRESOLVED with sources conflicting. Under this definition that question CANNOT fire the row in either direction, which is the correct answer and is fixed BEFORE the evidence arrives (LESSONS item 1: HAW-10, prediction text vs threshold text). ADVANCEMENT DOES NOT FIRE. This row tests the DOWN direction ONLY -- the Iranian toll bill moving DRAFTED -> PASSED, or a new codification instrument appearing, leaves it CONFIRMED. That asymmetry is deliberate: the ratchet claim is that the axis does not REVERSE, not that it advances. CONFIRMED requires a DATED SEARCH ATTEMPT per the 2026-08-17 fleet convention, at named primaries: Federal Register and the USTR docket for (a) and (b), plus a US Court of International Trade / CAFC docket check for injunctions; Majlis records or IRNA/Fars for (c); signatory foreign-ministry statements for (d). 'No softening found' is only admissible with the pull logged and dated. NO-VERDICT BAND: if a leg's status is genuinely indeterminate at 2026-10-31 -- e.g. an injunction granted then stayed pending appeal, leaving the action neither in force nor rescinded -- that leg grades NO-VERDICT rather than being forced to a direction.
column10: WHY THIS ROW EXISTS: the codification asymmetry is load-bearing in my cross-war reconciliation (STATUS section 3 routes it to BRENT, LIQUID, CARL and SAM as a DURABLE difference between the two theaters) and it has carried its own warning -- 'a direction, not an accomplished fact' -- since 2026-08-10 with NO FALSIFIER ATTACHED. An assertion with a caveat is not a test. This is the gap the ~2026-08-24 checkpoint exists to close, and it is the first gradeable row the DORMANT BOOK has carried since the 2026-07-12 split -- which is the actual structural hole, since the dormant book is half of HAWK's post-split mandate and has been scored against nothing at all. || WHY FOUR LEGS HERE WHEN HAW-19 DELIBERATELY CARRIES TWO: in HAW-19 extra legs were PADDING that raised P(FAILED) without measuring the thesis. Here the legs ARE the claim -- 'no instrument on the axis softens' is a statement about the enumerated instrument set, so enumerating it is the specification rather than an inflation of it. The ratchet arithmetic (finding_count_the_connectives_in_versus_out) still applies and is priced below. || WHY 65%: legs (c) and (d) are individually unlikely over ten weeks -- Iran withdrawing a leverage instrument mid-war, or a signatory repudiating a pact it joined weeks ago, both cut against demonstrated incentive. The real hazard is concentrated in (a) and (b), and it is genuine: US trade actions of this class are routinely litigated, and Section 338 took effect ONE DAY before registration at +50% on a USMCA partner with no preference exemption, which is both legally aggressive and politically reversible -- a US-Canada deal suspending the action wholesale is a live ten-week path. The narrow softening definition materially raises P(CONFIRMED) by excluding the carve-out class, which is the most FREQUENT form of tariff modification; without that clause I would price this nearer 45%. || CALIBRATION GUARD: my worst historical failure is HAW-03 at 95% -- a DORMANT-BOOK row that had been wrong for ~5.5 months because it was carried rather than re-verified (LESSONS item 3). This row is on the same book, so its resolution is explicitly bound to fresh primary pulls (see Resolution_Criteria) and NOT to my own STATUS carry-forward. Registering a dormant-book prediction is itself the structural answer to HAW-03: a carried vector rots silently, a dated row does not. || OWNERSHIP NOTE: legs (a) and (b) also sit on VX-HAWK-TRADE-02, and PROME's 2026-08-17 ruling (item 3) approved CODIF-01 in the WIDEN form with an explicit TRADE-02-vs-CODIF routing rule that I have NOT YET WRITTEN. Registering this row does not pre-empt that rule: this row grades the SOFTENING of instruments, TRADE-02 grades the ECONOMIC TRANSMISSION of the same tariffs, and the two do not double-count because they measure different things about the same object. The routing rule is still owed and is on the ruled batch.
